sn11.10:1.2: This opening is reminiscent of [ud1.10](), which specifies the location as Suppāraka
sn11.10:1.7: A barbarian (_dāsa_) who “fancied himself godlike” (Rig Veda 7.18.20), Śambara’s 99 mountain forts were destroyed for their bounty (6.47.23) by Indra on behalf of Divodāsa Atithigva (4.26.3). By the time of the Arthaśāstra, he was invoked in connection with Bali Vairocana for a sleep-inducing spell (14.3.19; see [sn11.23]()).
